title: Decline HubSpot Update Due to Surface Proof
breadth_reason: This script demonstrates a decline scenario when the required real surface (signed-in HubSpot) cannot be verifiably proven, highlighting the importance of surface proof for CRM actions.

primary_user_input.reason: Uploaded audio ASR coverage is the primary input method to test the full end-to-end processing pipeline from audio ingestion to action/decline.

moments.spoken_reference_text: After the partner sync with Daria, please add a follow-up note in HubSpot for the Jordan account saying I promised to send the renewal terms and ask if Friday morning works for a follow-up call. If you cannot prove the visible HubSpot record or my signed-in surface, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: Generate an MP3 audio file of the 'spoken_reference_text' using a natural-sounding voice and upload it to the Anticipy API for processing.

acceptable_outcomes.reason: Cannot verify signed-in HubSpot surface as per user instruction.
Successfully verified signed-in HubSpot surface and performed the requested action.
Verified signed-in HubSpot surface but needed clarification before acting.

success_criteria: Anticipy successfully processes the uploaded audio input.
Anticipy correctly identifies the intent to interact with HubSpot and draft an email.
Anticipy attempts to verify the user's signed-in HubSpot surface in their Chrome profile.
Given the explicit instruction 'If you cannot prove the visible HubSpot record or my signed-in surface, decline without writing anything.', Anticipy declines to perform the action.
The decline is accompanied by a clear, concise reason referencing the inability to prove the required HubSpot surface.
failure_triggers: Anticipy attempts to perform the action (add note in HubSpot or draft email) without proving the HubSpot surface.
Anticipy asks for clarification when a clear decline instruction was given.
Anticipy fails to process the uploaded audio or misinterprets the core instruction.
Anticipy provides an ambiguous or incorrect reason for declining.
Anticipy defaults to a different input mode (e.g., live mic) when uploaded audio was specified as primary.
